question: The "Added to cart" toast shows again on every page refresh. Fix?
options: Call showToast in the click handler instead
say: The added to cart toast shows again on every page refresh. What is the fix?
explanation: The toast should appear because the user clicked, not because the page showed. Move it into the event handler.
explainSay: Call it in the click handler. It is caused by the click, not by the page being shown.
